title: Everest 2026: a record spring season
summary: Nepal issued nearly 500 Everest permits and season summaries report roughly 1,000 summits, including a single-day record of 274 on 20 May. Kami Rita Sherpa reached the summit for a record 32nd time, and Nepal raised the Everest climbing fee from US$11,000 to US$15,000.

title: First winter ascent of K2
summary: A team of Nepali climbers reached the summit of K2 in winter, the last of the 8,000-metre peaks to be climbed in that season.

title: Everest re-measured
summary: Nepal and China jointly announced a new official height for Mount Everest of 8,848.86 metres.

title: Glacier retreat is changing mountain routes
summary: Retreating glaciers and thawing permafrost are changing Alpine routes and increasing the risk of rockfall, so climbers must check current conditions before every trip.
